PRIMARY_ENDPOINT: mean over covered NYSE full weekday closures of log(US_SESSION_SHARE_event / mean US_SESSION_SHARE_controls)

TEST_FORMALIZATION.Y: The vector of daily US-session quote-volume shares on the observed closure dates, their frozen controls, and every date a pseudo-holiday draw can select or use as a rebuilt control.
TEST_FORMALIZATION.Z_OBS: The 47 point-in-time verified NYSE full weekday closures, partitioned by year and weekday.
TEST_FORMALIZATION.OMEGA_PSEUDO: Cartesian product, over year-by-weekday strata that contain at least one closure, of the k-subsets of same-weekday dates in that year that lie outside holiday weeks, outside the contamination exclusions, and that have at least one eligible ±2-week control.
TEST_FORMALIZATION.T: Mean of log(share on the assigned date / mean share on that date's rebuilt ±2-week eligible controls).
TEST_FORMALIZATION.REASON: Each observed closure date is inside the Monday-Sunday week used to define holiday weeks, and the pseudo pool drops those weeks. All 47 observed dates are therefore ineligible for Omega_pseudo.

NOT_RANDOMIZATION_INFERENCE: NYSE closure dates were not generated by the pseudo-holiday sampling mechanism.
NOT_PERMUTATION_GROUP_INVARIANCE: The observed assignment is not an element of the transformation set, so that set is not the orbit of Z_obs.
REFERENCE_SUPPORT_RESOLUTION_MEANING: 1 over the number of pseudo-holiday assignments. This is the resolution of the full reference set. It is not an exact attainable p-value of a randomization test whose orbit contains Z_obs.
MONTE_CARLO_P_FORMULA: (1 + count of pseudo statistics at least as extreme) / (1 + 1000)
FINITE_SAMPLE_TYPE_I_CONTROL: Not implied by the size of Omega_pseudo. Type-I control requires the substantive reference-distribution assumption below.
RESIDUAL_VALIDITY_ASSUMPTION: Conditional on year, weekday, the frozen contamination exclusions, and the ±2-week control rule, the statistic on the actual NYSE closure dates under the null has the same distribution as the statistic on eligible non-holiday pseudo dates. Exchangeability among non-holiday days is not enough. The closure dates themselves must be exchangeable with that reference distribution for every calendar factor other than the hypothesized participant removal.
NULL_CALIBRATION_INTERPRETATION: Base null rejection 0.055 (binomial SE 0.0161) and stress null rejection 0.085 (binomial SE 0.0197) from 200 replicates. Both sampling intervals are wide enough to cover alpha 0.05. These 200 replicates do not establish that the stress reference test is calibrated or miscalibrated. No further calibration campaign was run.
